name: Mantine
summary: React component library with 120+ customizable components, 70 hooks and packages for forms, charts, dates and notifications.
description: A React components library with 120+ components and 70 hooks covering layout, inputs, comboboxes, overlays, navigation and data display, styled with CSS and a PostCSS preset so anything can be overridden. Extra packages add forms, charts, dates, notifications, a Ctrl+K spotlight, a Tiptap editor, dropzone and modals; docs ship llms.txt, agent skills and an MCP server for AI-assisted workflows.
contains: packages for hooks, forms, charts, dates, notifications, spotlight, modals, dropzone, carousel and a Tiptap editor
CSS-based styling with a PostCSS preset; dark color scheme
components for overlays, comboboxes, menus and data display
llms.txt, agent skills and an MCP server for AI workflows
